hero.headline: Let customers book themselves
hero.subheadline: No phone calls. No back-and-forth. Customers pick a service, choose a slot, and confirm — 24/7, from any device.

intro.headline: Zenly's booking engine runs the full appointment lifecycle so your team never has to.

primaryFeatures.title: 24/7 Self-Booking
primaryFeatures.description: Customers book from any device, any time — no staff intervention needed.

primaryFeatures.title: Zero Double-Bookings
primaryFeatures.description: Real-time slot locking prevents conflicts the moment a booking is made.

primaryFeatures.title: Instant Confirmation
primaryFeatures.description: Automated confirmations sent the moment a booking is created.

primaryFeatures.title: Service Catalog
primaryFeatures.description: Define services, durations, staff, and pricing — the booking form builds itself.

secondaryFeatures.title: Reschedule & Cancel
secondaryFeatures.description: Customers self-serve changes without calling in.

secondaryFeatures.title: Multi-Location Ready
secondaryFeatures.description: One booking flow works across every branch.

secondaryFeatures.title: Walk-in Support
secondaryFeatures.description: Fit walk-ins into available gaps without disrupting the schedule.

secondaryFeatures.title: Reminder Automation
secondaryFeatures.description: SMS and email reminders sent automatically before each appointment.

stat.label: Fewer no-shows
stat.description: Automated reminders cut missed appointments nearly in half.

hero.headline: Your whole floor, visible at a glance
hero.subheadline: Real-time dashboards for every role. Staff see their queue, managers see the floor, admins see everything — from one screen.

intro.headline: Run the floor without the chaos
intro.body: Every role gets the right view. No more status chasing, missed queues, or payment confusion — Zenly's operations layer keeps everyone on the same page in real time.

primaryFeatures.title: Role-Based Dashboards
primaryFeatures.description: Staff, managers, and admins each see a tailored view — no information overload, no blind spots.

primaryFeatures.title: Live Booking Status
primaryFeatures.description: See who's in, who's next, and what's pending — updated the moment anything changes.

primaryFeatures.title: Discount Governance
primaryFeatures.description: Staff apply only the discounts they're authorized for. Managers review any exceptions.

primaryFeatures.title: Staff & Room Assignment
primaryFeatures.description: Assign services to specific staff or rooms, and track availability in real time.

secondaryFeatures.title: Payment Recording
secondaryFeatures.description: Mark payments at point of service — cash, card, or wallet.

secondaryFeatures.title: Multi-Branch Visibility
secondaryFeatures.description: Managers see all branches from one consolidated dashboard.

secondaryFeatures.title: Queue Management
secondaryFeatures.description: Walk-ins and scheduled appointments share one live queue.

secondaryFeatures.title: Status Tracking
secondaryFeatures.description: Track every appointment through pending, in-progress, and completed states.

stat.label: Faster day-close
stat.description: Teams close out the day three times faster with live operations tracking.

hero.headline: Close your day in 30 seconds
hero.subheadline: Automated reconciliation, payment breakdowns by mode, and a full audit trail. No Excel. No guesswork.

intro.headline: Financial clarity without the spreadsheets
intro.body: Every rupee accounted for, every day. Zenly captures each payment, breaks it down by mode, and locks the day automatically — giving you a clean audit trail without manual work.

primaryFeatures.title: Daily Revenue Close
primaryFeatures.description: One-click end-of-day closing with a full revenue summary per service and staff.

primaryFeatures.title: Payment Mode Breakdown
primaryFeatures.description: See totals by cash, card, wallet, and more — every day, every branch.

primaryFeatures.title: Full Audit Trail
primaryFeatures.description: Every transaction recorded with timestamps, staff, and service — fully traceable.

primaryFeatures.title: Day-End Lock
primaryFeatures.description: Lock the day once reconciled so no entries can be altered after closing.

secondaryFeatures.title: Pricing Snapshots
secondaryFeatures.description: Prices at time of service are locked in — historical accuracy guaranteed.

secondaryFeatures.title: Pending Payment Tracking
secondaryFeatures.description: See outstanding balances and follow up before they're forgotten.

secondaryFeatures.title: Discount Reporting
secondaryFeatures.description: Track every discount applied, by whom, and when.

secondaryFeatures.title: Revenue History
secondaryFeatures.description: Trend your daily revenue week over week, month over month.

stat.label: To close the day
stat.description: Automated reconciliation means end-of-day takes a click, not an hour.

hero.headline: Every number, always explained
hero.subheadline: Eight built-in reports covering revenue, staff performance, discounts, attendance, and referrals — always up to date.

intro.headline: Eight reports. Zero setup. Always live.
intro.body: Zenly's built-in reports run automatically — no configuration, no exports, no waiting. Open the dashboard and your numbers are already there.

primaryFeatures.title: Revenue Reports
primaryFeatures.description: Daily, weekly, and monthly revenue broken down by service, staff, and branch.

primaryFeatures.title: Staff Performance
primaryFeatures.description: See bookings completed, revenue generated, and discounts applied per staff member.

primaryFeatures.title: Discount Analytics
primaryFeatures.description: Track total discounts, types, and authorization patterns across the business.

primaryFeatures.title: Referral Tracking
primaryFeatures.description: Understand which referral sources are driving the most bookings and revenue.

secondaryFeatures.title: Attendance Reports
secondaryFeatures.description: Track client visit frequency and spot patterns in no-shows or repeat visits.

secondaryFeatures.title: Exportable Data
secondaryFeatures.description: Download any report as CSV for further analysis or compliance.

secondaryFeatures.title: Always Live
secondaryFeatures.description: Reports update in real time — no manual refresh, no stale data.

secondaryFeatures.title: 8 Built-in Reports
secondaryFeatures.description: Revenue, staff, discounts, referrals, attendance, and more — ready on day one.

stat.label: Built-in reports
stat.description: Every key business metric covered out of the box — no setup required.

hero.headline: One platform, any service business
hero.subheadline: Every vertical gets its own terminology, feature flags, and service categories — zero code changes to onboard a new business type.

intro.headline: Built to fit every service business
intro.body: Whether you run a spa, a clinic, or a salon chain, Zenly adapts to your terminology, your workflows, and your service structure — without custom development.

primaryFeatures.title: Zero-Code Onboarding
primaryFeatures.description: New business types go live with a config change — no development work needed.

primaryFeatures.title: Custom Terminology
primaryFeatures.description: Labels, statuses, and field names match your industry's language exactly.

primaryFeatures.title: Feature Flags Per Vertical
primaryFeatures.description: Enable only the features that make sense for each business type.

primaryFeatures.title: Service Category Mapping
primaryFeatures.description: Define services, categories, and durations exactly as your industry requires.

secondaryFeatures.title: Spa & Wellness
secondaryFeatures.description: Treatment rooms, therapist assignments, and session-based booking.

secondaryFeatures.title: Hair Salon
secondaryFeatures.description: Chair-based scheduling, service bundles, and style-specific staff matching.

secondaryFeatures.title: Dental Clinic
secondaryFeatures.description: Appointment slots, patient record integration, and multi-chair management.

secondaryFeatures.title: Fitness & PT
secondaryFeatures.description: Session packs, trainer scheduling, and class-based booking.

stat.label: Supported verticals

hero.headline: Scale across every location
hero.subheadline: Org-scoped data isolation, branch-level operations, and consolidated admin dashboards across any number of locations.

intro.headline: Manage every location from one place
intro.body: Each branch runs independently — its own staff, operations, and data. But your admin sees all of it from one consolidated dashboard, so nothing slips through the cracks.

primaryFeatures.title: Branch-Level Isolation
primaryFeatures.description: Each branch has its own bookings, staff, and financials — fully separated.

primaryFeatures.title: Consolidated Admin Dashboard
primaryFeatures.description: See performance, revenue, and operations across all branches in one view.

primaryFeatures.title: Cross-Branch Visibility
primaryFeatures.description: Identify your best-performing branches and replicate what works.

primaryFeatures.title: Per-Branch Operations
primaryFeatures.description: Each location runs its own daily operations without affecting others.

secondaryFeatures.title: Per-Branch Pricing
secondaryFeatures.description: Set different service prices per location without system-wide changes.

secondaryFeatures.title: Staff Assignment
secondaryFeatures.description: Staff are scoped to their branch — no cross-branch confusion.

secondaryFeatures.title: Branch Comparison Reports
secondaryFeatures.description: Compare revenue, bookings, and performance side by side.

secondaryFeatures.title: Unlimited Scale
secondaryFeatures.description: Add new locations as you grow — no architecture changes required.

stat.label: To go live
stat.description: New branches are configured and operational in under a day — no technical work needed.
